report.scope: Intent: show an estimated time of the next usage-limit hit, from the view's usage.limits and usage.hourly, with no exporter or local change. Acceptance: AC-80 (FR-117, FR-118): with no limit hit recorded the page shows 'no forecast: no limit hit recorded'; with at least one, a time labelled as an estimate, on the Claude usage tab and as a compact Overview tile, following the project or session view. Method: ledger row 11 and PRD A-34 defer to 'the PRD default as written', which names no method; implemented the simplest method consistent with brief feature 6 (lines 192-193): the mean time from when work last resumed (the latest reset before the hit, else the start of the recorded hourly usage) to each hit, added to the latest hit or reset. Grounding path: ran-suite (node tests/page.test.mjs, python -m unittest discover -s tests, python -m unittest discover -s local/tests).
report.summary: 2 files modified (site/index.html, tests/page.test.mjs); 6 page checks added. Page suite 63 passed / 0 failed (baseline 57); tests suite 215 passed / 0 failed; local/tests 90 passed / 0 failed. Verification tier 3, all three configured suites run. Change-report not validated against tools/change_report_schema.py, whose only copy is under ~/.claude, which was out of bounds. Nothing committed, staged, pushed or deployed.

changes.why: Adds limitsOf (usage.limits read as a list of objects only), forecastOf (the estimate method) and forecastTile, which shows the estimate, or 'no forecast: no limit hit recorded', or 'no forecast: too little timing data to estimate', in the neutral --rule-2 tone. Adds the tile to the Claude usage tab, the project Overview and the Other sessions Overview, plus a note in the Usage limits panel on how the estimate is derived and that it is not a plan meter. Moves the chart, usage panel and Limit-hits tiles to limitsOf so a malformed usage.limits no longer throws.

Section 11: forecast checks with hand-computed expected times, covering the project view, the session filter, Other sessions, the no-hit text, the method note, the tile tone and malformed usage.limits.

tests.covers: project view with 3 hits stored out of order: 2099-01-01T16:00Z, 'estimate from the last 3 limit hits', identical on the usage tab and the Overview
method note (estimate, 'average time from a reset', 'not a plan meter'); forecast tile tone is a token and never --human
session filter with 1 hit: 2026-09-10T16:30Z from the session's own usage, 'estimate from the last 1 limit hit · passed with no hit since'
project with no limits: exact text 'no forecast: no limit hit recorded' on the usage tab and the Overview
Other sessions: a session with no hits shows no forecast; a session with 3 hits shows its own estimate
malformed usage.limits ('x', 7, {}, null, a bare object, [null, 3, 'x', [], [hit]]) and untimed hits: no crash, no console.error, no-forecast text, Limit hits 0
